locked_rule: No PIX-derived audio object may be displayed, sold, sent, delivered, fulfilled, routed to checkout, or treated as receiver-ready unless Delivery Proof is complete.
scope: past approved items when reused, republished, resent, or repackaged
public_flow_note: mKs remain banned from public buyer flow unless explicitly re-approved by owner. This Delivery Proof standard still applies internally to any mK/LFL/derivative that is rendered, reviewed, archived, delivered privately, reused, or later reconsidered.

clarification.bridge_term: Bridge was only the working label for one Thank You section candidate. The Delivery Proof and render rules are not limited to structural Bridges.
clarification.universal_application: The same Delivery Proof standard applies to every PIX-derived audio object regardless of structure label or derivative type.

delivery_proof_required.description: Campaign use is separated from true source identity and does not trap reuse.
Recipient, sentiment, situation, emotional weight, and delivery shape are reviewed.
Holiday, recipient, romance, grief, or other wrong-fit language is checked.
Start point is approved by human listening.
End point is approved by human listening and musical sustain is not cut incorrectly.
Music/vocal final note is allowed to complete correctly before treatment.
KK/mK/LFL/derivative content fades at its own final note/end before Twinkle.
Tail space exists after content fade and before Twinkle.
Twinkle/end treatment is present where required for II/HUG delivery.
Twinkle is low signature-level and must not compete with the content.
Public/review/checkout/send audio points to final DP render, not raw micro-capture.
Human approval status and notes are recorded in proof data.
Display, checkout, send, and fulfillment are gated to approved Delivery Proof renders only.
